# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains a large number of short call snippets, the majority of which are internal/operational (vehicle loading, driver coordination, GST/billing paperwork, Porter cab cancellations, personal chat, wedding invitations, India Mart lead-sharing). Only a subset are genuine sales calls — rate enquiries, stock checks, order confirmations, and a handful of outbound cold calls. Within that subset, pricing and product mentions are fairly repetitive (same JSW/Asian/Indradhanush rate quotes recur across many calls on the same dates), so the real "sales conversation" variety is modest. This KB is built strictly from those genuine sales exchanges — rate quoting, product clarification, objection handling, order/payment negotiation. Operational chatter (crane/driver/bill-copy/attendance) has been excluded even where it sat between sales lines.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing & Structures sells **color-coated steel roofing sheets and related accessories**, not a general hardware line. Product lines actually discussed in calls:

- **Color-coated/galvalume roofing sheets (profile sheets)** — core product. Brands mentioned: **JSW Coloron Plus**, **JSW Pragathi**, **JSW Color On Plus/L Plus**, **JSW Indradhanush-equivalent**, **Asian Indradhanush** (cheaper alternative), **Radiance**, **Kalaran (Kalavan) Plus**. Customers often ask "JSW-ல வேற எதுனா brand கம்மியா இருக்குங்களா?" and are steered to Asian Indradhanush as the budget option.
- **Thicknesses offered**: 0.45 mm, 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.60 mm (0.72 mm asked for but **not stocked** — "0.72 இருக்காது சார், 0.60 தான் இருக்கும்").
- **Colors**: Sky Blue, Off White, Brick Red, Graphite/Pencil Grey (same thing — "Pencil Grey, Graphite Grey எல்லாமே ஒண்ணுதான்"), Royal Blue/Nova Blue, Mist Green, and a "Bare"/Silver uncoated steel option.
- **Plain/GI/GL/PPGI/PPGL coils and sheets** — sold to B2B buyers (e.g., Cochin PPGL coil enquiry, 150 GSM galvalume requests).
- **Puff/sandwich panel sheets** (insulated roof panels, 30/40/50 mm) — explicitly **supply-only, no fabrication/fixing**: "நாங்க insulation பண்ண மாட்டோம், நாங்க supply மட்டும் தாங்க பண்றோம்."
- **Polycarbonate sheets** (blue) — no fixed "standard size," cut to square-meter requirement.
- **Accessories**: Ridges, L-flashing, flash cutters, deep trim, down pipes, gutters (e.g., 150×75), rectangular "crimp/gripper loop" trims (often customer terminology doesn't match company catalog and needs a diagram to resolve).
- **Screws/fasteners**: Tata-brand roofing screws (various sizes — 19 mm, 25 mm, 1 inch, 5.5 inch stitch screws), hex-head screws — sold by carton/box.
- **Welding electrodes, cutting & grinding wheels, Purlins (Perlin), square/round MS pipes** — mentioned as adjacent product lines in an India Mart lead-sharing call, confirming the company's broader catalog beyond sheets.

No evidence in these calls of trusses, full fabrication, or site installation — company positions itself purely as a **material supplier/distributor**.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

Rates fluctuate day to day (staff repeatedly warn "price validity 1 day"), so multiple figures for the same product are genuine, not errors:

- **JSW Coloron Plus**: 0.47 mm = ₹445 + GST/m²; 0.50 mm = ₹475 + GST/m² (repeated across many calls); earlier figure ₹435/₹465+GST also quoted on different days.
- **JSW Pragathi**: ₹375–₹475 + GST/m² across different calls (₹405, ₹415, ₹475 all appear); per-kg version also quoted: ₹107 (cash & carry) / ₹108 (credit), later ₹109.
- **Asian Indradhanush** 0.45 mm = ₹380 + GST/m² (consistent across calls).
- **Kalaran/Kalavan Plus**: ₹435–₹455 + GST (price rising — "2-3 நாளா ஏத்தாம தான் இருக்காங்க").
- **Silver/Steel Bare (uncoated)** ~₹395 + GST/m²; **Color On Plus** 0.50 mm = ₹117+GST/kg, 0.47 mm = ₹119+GST/kg.
- **Polycarbonate**: ₹800 + GST per square meter ("KM rate தான் வரும்").
- **Puff sheet**: ₹1300 (30 mm, top/bottom 40/35), **loading charge ₹1000** extra for ~470 sq ft.
- **Accessories (L-flashing/ridge/cutter, Coloron 50)**: below 610 mm width = ₹635+GST per piece; 610–1220 mm width = ₹1275+GST per piece; down-pipe adds ₹250 extra; all accessory pieces standard at 2.5 m length.
- **Loading charge** generic: ₹1.25/m² mentioned once for sheet dispatch.
- **Screws**: dealer price ~₹3.8/piece quoted once; cartons sized at 500–5000 pieces depending on size; a flat 10% price hike was announced from **1st November** for Tata screws and electrodes.
- **Payment terms**: Standard ask is **50% advance + 50% before delivery** ("against delivery பண்ண முடியாது"); one dealer PO stated 30% advance but staff corrected it to 50%. Billing name must match the **payer's bank account name** or GST certificate name — repeatedly enforced ("யார் பேர்ல இருந்து payment வருதோ அந்த nameல தான் பில்லிங் போட முடியும்").
- **Delivery**: typical promise 1–3
